data: In the left graph, does the blue line increase as the value of the X-axis increases?

The left graph is labeled as Figure 2(a). The X-axis represents the value of α, and the Y-axis represents G-BLEU. The blue line represents G-BLEU, and the orange line represents Acc. The question asks whether the blue line increases as the value of the X-axis increases.

To analyze this, I will look at the trend of the blue line across the X-axis values. From the left graph, I can see that the blue line starts at approximately 18.5 on the Y-axis when α is around 0.3 and increases to approximately 21 on the Y-axis when α is around 0.7. This indicates that the blue line does indeed increase as the value of the X-axis increases.
